title: Response
description: CLI output envelope: `ok`, the request `command`, then `result` and/or `error`.

Benchmark.description: Timing of the repeated trace; see `timed_scope` for what is measured.

seed.description: First source seed; later sources use consecutive seeds. None preserves originals.

back.description: Incidence from the plus side; omission uses the front model on both sides.

front.description: Incidence from the minus side of the surface normal.

zemax_definition.description: Original named coating block, including S/P and phase data for lossless exchange.

coefficients.description: Angle-major, then wavelength; each element is [R, T] in power units.

low_index_angle.description: Zemax TABLE angles refer to the lower-index medium on either traversal.

occurrence.description: The occurrence; None denotes a single system traced as it is.

Conditions.description: Calculation conditions that change how imported definitions are traced.

allow_uncoated.description: Trace coated surfaces as uncoated Fresnel interfaces (changes the physics).

monochromatic_override_um.description: Replace every source spectrum with one wavelength in micrometres.

ConvergencePlan.description: `plan` of the `convergence` command. Every combination is traced.

allow_uncoated.description: Trace coated surfaces as uncoated Fresnel interfaces.

cad_deflections_mm.description: CAD tessellation deflections in mm; needs the original STEP-referencing ZMX.

pixels.description: Detector pixel counts `[x, y]`; empty keeps the model setting.

ray_counts.description: Rays per source; an empty list keeps the model setting.

save_runs.description: Save a replayable calculation record for each case.

seeds.description: Seed of the first source (later sources use +1, +2, ...); empty keeps the model setting.

wavelength_um.description: Replace the source spectra with one wavelength in micrometres.

Design.description: The design document. Compile it with [`Design::compile`] or [`Design::trace_scene`].

name.description:
Name, reference plane, tracing mode and limits of a composed design. A single
system part placed without transform (see [`Design::lone_system`]) is traced
as it is and uses its own scene header instead.

next_id.description: Next number for new ids; numbers are never reused.

occurrences.description: Root-level placements in order; names of composed surfaces use their position.

weights.description: Row-major: row y, column x. Values are integrated pixel power, not density.

traceable.description: False when an enabled component has a `requires_override` or `unsupported` entry.

oneOf.description: The minus/plus medium is on the -/+ side of the local sag normal.

origin_mm.description: Position from which the failed interface search started.

Issue.description: A condition found while importing or editing a definition.

blocking.description: An unsupported physical definition prevents tracing.

oneOf.description: n² = 1 + sum(B_i * lambda² / (lambda² - C_i)). C_i has units um².
n² = A0 + A1*l² + A2/l² + A3/l⁴ + A4/l⁶ + A5/l⁸ (AGF formula 1).
Sorted [wavelength_um, n] pairs. Linear interpolation, no extrapolation.

Mode.description:
`sequential` follows the surface order and terminates at TIR;
`non_sequential` follows the nearest hit and splits reflection and transmission.

Occurrence.description: A placed instance of a part: a rigid transform plus an enabled switch.

anchor_mm.description: Local point placed at `pose.translation_mm`: lens first vertex or source-array centre.

OccurrenceId.description: Identifier of a occurrence, unique within the design document.

Outcome.description: Result of one request; the shape follows the request `command`.

Parameter.description:
Scanned value. Components are addressed by occurrence id and surfaces by name; axis
0/1/2 is X/Y/Z.

oneOf.description: Rod width X / width Y / length (axis 0/1/2) in mm, of the occurrence's rod part.

Surface position in mm, in the coordinates of its part. Without `occurrence` the
design must be a single unplaced system.
Surface rotation in degrees, in the coordinates of its part.
Wavelength of every source in micrometres.

ParameterLink.description: target = source * scale + offset; scale is dimensionless, offset uses target units.

Part.description: A part definition in its own local coordinates.

issues.description: Import findings that may block tracing.

material_names.description: One display name per entry of `scene.materials`.

scene.description:
Local optical definition: materials, surfaces, sources, and (for a `system`
part) the name, reference plane, tracing mode and limits of the whole system.
A `rod` part keeps its material in slot 1; its six faces are generated from `rod`.

PartId.description: Identifier of a part, unique within the design document.

oneOf.description: A complete optical system: surfaces, sources and tracing mode.

rotation_deg.description: Active rotations: Rx, then Ry, then Rz, in the world frame.

Provenance.description:
Where a part was imported from. The document keeps it as an opaque JSON value;
only the input/output layer interprets it (for example to export ZMX again).

format.description: Name of the source format, for example `zmx`.

PupilIllumination.description:
Uniform area samples on a pupil. Finite objects emit from a point; infinite
objects launch a parallel bundle whose intersections fill the pupil.

coatings.description: Optional power coatings on entrance, exit, or sides.

design.description:
The editor state, including original documents, parts, placements and overrides.
Records saved by earlier builds hold this as `project` and are migrated on load.

scene.description: Exact effective scene after CLI overrides or GUI preview limits.

RunOutput.description:
Calculation record written by `trace` and `replay`.
`replay` reruns `calculation` with the recorded optical conditions.

calculation.description: Frozen design, effective scene, launch input and software version used for replay.

detector_percent_of_reference.description: Integrated power on each detector, by detector name, as a percentage of `reference_weight`.

reference_weight.description: Launched weight sum; every `*_percent_of_reference` field divides by this value.

relative_budget_closure_error.description: `(accounted - launched) / launched` of the power budget.

report.description: Raw trace report: budget, detector pixel weights, surface totals and diagnostics.

schema_version.description: Output layout version of the record.

trace_seconds.description: Median trace time in seconds (same as `benchmark.median_seconds`).

ScanPlan.description: `plan` of the `scan` command. At most 256 cases.

rays_per_source.description: Rays per source for every case; null keeps the model setting.

secondary.description: Optional second axis; every combination with `values` is traced.

values.description: Values of `parameter` in its unit (mm, deg or um).

Scene.description:
Optical model: materials, surfaces, sources and trace limits.
Lengths are mm and wavelengths are micrometres. `examples/*.json` use this format.

materials.description: Material table; surfaces and rays refer to materials by index. Index 0 is usually air.

reference_plane.description: Describes where the launched weight is counted as 100 %.

surfaces.description: Surfaces in sequential order (non-sequential tracing uses the nearest hit).

oneOf.description: Side of a closed lens barrel: z in [0,length], outward-pointing normal.
Coefficients are A4, A6, A8, ... in increasing order.
The vertex-centred sag cap; radius is signed. This is not a full sphere.
Coefficients are A4, A6, A8, ... in increasing order.

total_weight.description: Arbitrary power units; the sum at launch defines the reference plane.

samples.description: Ascending [wavelength_um, relative_power] pairs, sampled without interpolation.

SurfacePercent.description:
Per-surface encounter totals as percentages of the launched weight.
Repeated encounters with the same surface are summed.

branch_count.description: Counts terminal branches, not unique launch IDs.

path_launch_count.description: Store every segment belonging to the first N launch rays in input order, including branches.

output.description: Saved calculation record, if `output` was given.

warnings.description: Unresolved weight and other conditions worth checking in the record.
